title_candidates: GPT-5.6 is generally available in three versions
summary: OpenAI's GPT-5.6 family is now generally available as Sol, Terra, and Luna, giving users clearer choices among capability, speed, and cost.

primary_source.title: GPT-5.6: Frontier intelligence that scales with your ambition
primary_source.author: OpenAI
key_facts: GPT-5.6 is generally available after an earlier limited preview.
Sol targets the hardest work, Terra balances quality and speed, and Luna targets economical high-volume use.
The family is available through ChatGPT and the API, subject to product and plan controls.

prerequisites: A ChatGPT account showing two GPT-5.6 options
A task with a checkable answer

steps.instruction: Run one bounded task with two visible GPT-5.6 variants.
Compare errors, missed instructions, speed, and editing time.
Use the least expensive model that reliably meets the task's quality bar.
